name: Keldrannon Aurel Galens
source:
Height: 6'4
Birthday: Alsol 15th

Surrounded by rumors but rarely appearing in court, the Second Prince of the Galatean Empire seems to be an arrogant imperial with little regard for others and an ill-reputation that precedes him. Behind this façade lies the heart of a cunning warrior, and perhaps even a hidden romantic side that years for adventure.
